# v0.6.1 — In-house EL engine, full crates.io publish

## Highlights

- **EL engine:** in-house ELK-style completion in `ontologos-el` (whelk git dependency removed)
- **`ontologos-bridge`:** core ↔ horned-owl/oxrdf/reasonable adapters only
- **All library crates** publishable to crates.io (`ontologos-core` through `ontologos-explain`)
- Pizza EL golden regenerated for in-house EL (`84` direct subsumptions)
- EL inference traces and proof graphs enabled again

## Published crates

- **crates.io:** all library crates at **0.6.1**
- **PyPI:** `ontologos` **0.6.1**

## Upgrade notes

If you pinned **0.6.0** for facade crates that were workspace-only, upgrade all `ontologos-*` crates to **0.6.1** together:

```toml
ontologos-core = "0.6.1"
ontologos-bridge = "0.6.1"
ontologos-el = "0.6.1"
# … same for parser, profile, rdfs, rl, query, explain
```

Python: `pip install ontologos==0.6.1`

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) for full details.
